decision: Plan A is CONTRACT-ONLY (operator directive). It adds the evidence contract to the existing view-state producer (source_kind + confidence + evidence_basis + provenance per node/edge; unresolved-as-low-confidence; extractor-coverage block; as_built/intent layer split + diff taxonomy). EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED: ADR/doc extractor (Plan B), Swift/Gradle/Xcode/JS/routing/API/infra extractors (Plan C+), UI overhaul + drift surfacing + annotation (Plan D). intent layer + diff list ship EMPTY in v0. Rationale: contract before coverage keeps a thin model honest and gives a stable boundary the later extractor/UI plans build against, without exploding scope.

Sequencing (operator call): 007 merges to main FIRST; THEN this plan is drafted + reviewed; 008 (terminal chrome/theming/state matrix) does NOT start until Plan A is at least drafted + reviewed, because 008 touches the broader operator-console trust surface and must not hard-code confidence/freshness assumptions Plan A will replace; Plan A LOCKS/BUILDS only after 007 is on main. This plan is drafted on branch feat/architecture-evidence-contract-v0 off main (doc-only, independent of 007's code) so it can live on main the moment 007 lands. NOT locked, NOT built.

confidence must encode extractor presence, not just resolution method: an evidence kind with NO extractor for this repo (e.g. Swift in a Swift app) must render LOW/limited coverage rather than a confident map shaped by whatever extractor DID run. This is the governs-not-executes posture applied to architecture — prove what is extractable, be loud about what is not. The coverage block (F003) is where this honesty is asserted; per-element confidence (F001) inherits it.

Pre-lock review fixes (operator): (1) added the required ## Target section (target_env=dev, target_project=none) so plan-review stops failing with PlanTargetError before features; (2) SEPARATED source_kind (WHERE) from evidence_basis (HOW) — removed 'inferred' from source_kind (it is a basis), added external/unknown/runtime to source_kind; (3) evidence_basis enum is observed|declared|inferred|unresolved (added declared for manifests/curated catalogs + unresolved, so they aren't forced into observed/inferred); (4) confidence is now a PRECEDENCE RULE not examples (high=resolved source/build endpoint; medium=declared/curated citing source_path; low=unresolved/heuristic/no-coverage); (5) F003 coverage statuses are a closed set covered|not_found|missing_extractor|not_applicable|error where missing_extractor (repo has the kind, DontPanic lacks an extractor) is distinct from not_applicable (kind can't apply) and pulls coverage DOWN; (6) F004 made backward-compatible: top-level nodes/edges REMAIN as compatibility aliases of as_built.nodes/edges so the 007 map + .mmd export are unaffected. Still status:draft; lock only after 007 lands on main.

Locked using the per-feature `introduces` affordance from precursor plan 2026-06-07-002 (now on main). Each feature declares the contract symbols it defines: F001 source_kind/evidence_basis/confidence/provenance/unknown_confidence; F003 coverage statuses; F004 as_built/intent + diff-taxonomy enum. plan-review went 13 block-severity → 0 (verdict OK); F002's use of source_kind shows as `resolved-via-introduces: source_kind from F001`.
rationale: Dogfoods 002 end-to-end and keeps the contract's exact enum names (we did NOT reword the plan to dodge the lint, per the standing constraint).
